mapper.select: SELECT POST_NO, USER_NAME, POST_TITLE, POST_CONTENT, CREATED_DATE, VIEW_COUNT FROM ( SELECT r, POST_NO, USER_NAME, POST_TITLE, POST_CONTENT, CREATED_DATE, VIEW_COUNT FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY POST_NO DESC) AS r, POST_NO, USER_NAME, POST_TITLE, POST_CONTENT, CREATED_DATE, VIEW_COUNT FROM COMMUNITY ) a WHERE r <= (#{pageNum} * #{amount}) ) aa WHERE r > (#{pageNum}-1) * #{amount}
